tickets.description: Washing machine (LG, landlord-supplied) not working: power failure. Tenant offers to replace it with her own machine, which would stay hers.

landlord_decision.conditions: Flat 9, 59 Alder Lane: tenant may fit her own machine, it remains hers and she takes it when she leaves; landlord pays removal of the old LG up to £30.
landlord_decision.evidence_quote: Yeah, that's fine. She can have her own and take it with her. I'll pay for the old one to go, up to thirty pounds.
